# Message from the Operations Director

**To:** Delivery team  
**Subject:** Keep the portal focused

The Member Service Portal should make routine requests faster. Requiring a
manager to approve every request would preserve the delay we are trying to
remove. Approval should be reserved for exceptional or costly requests.

Selected partner staff also need access because they submit facilities and
access requests on behalf of our teams.

I would prefer a pilot with two departments in November, followed by a gradual
rollout. A reliable launch matters more than meeting the date discussed at the
kickoff.

For routine service requests, two years of searchable history should be
enough.
